mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shooting_location ( source_location_id, source_variant_no, place_name, sido, sigungu, lot_address, road_address, latitude, longitude, source_conflict_yn, quality_flags_json, search_text, active_yn, created_at ) VALUES ( #{sourceLocationId}, #{sourceVariantNo}, #{placeName}, #{sido}, #{sigungu}, #{lotAddress}, #{roadAddress}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{sourceConflictYn}, #{qualityFlagsJson}, #{searchText}, 'Y', NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE location_id = LAST_INSERT_ID(location_id), place_name = VALUES(place_name), sido = VALUES(sido), sigungu = VALUES(sigungu), lot_address = VALUES(lot_address), road_address = VALUES(road_address), latitude = VALUES(latitude), longitude = VALUES(longitude), source_conflict_yn = VALUES(source_conflict_yn), quality_flags_json = VALUES(quality_flags_json), search_text = VALUES(search_text), active_yn = 'Y', updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO shooting_location_history ( location_id, source_event_id, movie_code, movie_title, production_year, scene_description, characters, source_name, source_url, raw_row_json, created_at ) VALUES ( #{locationId}, #{sourceEventId}, #{movieCode}, #{movieTitle}, #{productionYear}, #{sceneDescription}, #{characters}, #{sourceName}, #{sourceUrl}, #{rawRowJson}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE location_id = VALUES(location_id), movie_code = VALUES(movie_code), movie_title = VALUES(movie_title), production_year = VALUES(production_year), scene_description = VALUES(scene_description), characters = VALUES(characters), source_name = VALUES(source_name), source_url = VALUES(source_url), raw_row_json = VALUES(raw_row_json)
